title: Netcapital Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Netcapital Inc. (NCPL) filed an 8-K disclosing the termination of CEO Rich Wheeless on April 12, 2026 and the subsequent appointment of Todd Violette as CEO on April 13, 2026, along with the terms of Violette's employment agreement including a $120,000 annual base salary.
key_points: Rich Wheeless was terminated as CEO effective April 12, 2026 by Board vote
Todd Violette appointed CEO effective April 13, 2026 for a twelve-month term
Violette's base salary is $120,000 per year with potential bonus/stock option grants
Violette is 56 years old and previously worked at Network 1 Financial Securities from May 2025 to April 2026
Employment agreement includes two-year post-employment non-compete and non-solicitation covenants
